reasons.plausibility: Using an MTP-based reference to improve sampling versus EAM is scientifically sound, but inconsistencies (e.g., mentioning different alloy systems) raise questions about direct applicability.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of FEP(MTP) and TI(EAM) with a clear acceptance criterion (within 0.5 meV/atom) provides a feasible and decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: Replacing EAM with an MTP reference for more accurate free-energy calculations in multicomponent alloys is a useful proposal, though clarity on experimental details would increase its practical value.
